exact_project_owned_definitions.singleBlockPrecision:
noncomputable def singleBlockPrecision {n : ℕ} (κ : ℝ)
    (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ :=
  ((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) -
    ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) +
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose)
exact_project_owned_definitions.blockCoordinates:
private def blockCoordinates (d n : ℕ) :
    ((Fin n × Fin (d / n)) ⊕ Fin (d % n)) ≃ Fin d :=
  ((Equiv.sumCongr
    ((Equiv.prodComm (Fin n) (Fin (d / n))).trans finProdFinEquiv)
    (Equiv.refl (Fin (d % n)))).trans finSumFinEquiv).trans
    (finCongr (by simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_add_mod d n))
exact_project_owned_definitions.blockPrecision:
noncomputable def blockPrecision {d n : ℕ} (κ : ℝ)
    (O : Fin (d / n) → Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
  Matrix.reindex (blockCoordinates d n) (blockCoordinates d n)
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun j => singleBlockPrecision κ (O j)))
      0 0 (1 : Matrix (Fin (d % n)) (Fin (d % n)) ℝ))

exact_signatures.blockPrecision_regular:
theorem blockPrecision_regular {d n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (_hnd : n ≤ d)
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ)
    (O : Fin (d / n) → Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (blockPrecision κ O).IsHermitian ∧
      ∀ x : Fin d → ℝ,
        x ⬝ᵥ x ≤ x ⬝ᵥ (blockPrecision κ O *ᵥ x) ∧
        x ⬝ᵥ (blockPrecision κ O *ᵥ x) ≤ κ * (x ⬝ᵥ x)
exact_signatures.blockPrecision_unique_minimizer:
theorem blockPrecision_unique_minimizer {d n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hnd : n ≤ d)
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ)
    (O : Fin (d / n) → Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
    let f : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (x ⬝ᵥ (blockPrecision κ O *ᵥ x))
    f 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ (f x = 0 ↔ x = 0)

coordinate_adapter.blockDiagonal_source: Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Block.lean:329-330 indexes (inner,block) and checks block equality.
coordinate_adapter.prodComm_then_finProdFinEquiv: prodComm sends (inner,block) to (block,inner). Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Fin/Basic.lean:334-336 maps this to inner+n*block. Without the swap the ordering would interleave blocks, but the sealed body includes the required swap.
coordinate_adapter.sum_and_cast: finSumFinEquiv at :228-241 leaves the block-part value and adds k*n on the right tail. finCongr changes only size proof, preserving coordinate values.
coordinate_adapter.tail_equality: Nat.div_add_mod d n, commuted, gives k*n+r=d; since k*n<=d, r=d-k*n in naturals. Thus Fin(d%n) is exactly source residual carrier.
coordinate_adapter.reindex_direction: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Defs.lean:526-534 defines reindex e e M at u,v by M(e.symm u)(e.symm v). Hence evaluated at images e a,e b it recovers M a b; no reversed representation mistake.
coordinate_adapter.entrywise_formula: For block-coordinate images of (i,j),(i2,j2), entry is singleBlockPrecision kappa (O j) i i2 when j=j2 and zero otherwise. Block-tail and tail-block entries vanish. Tail-tail is Kronecker identity. Hence exact contiguous diagonal formula Eq5 on Fin d, not merely an unspecified permutation-conjugate matrix.
coordinate_adapter.zero_tail: If kn=d then r=0, Fin0 has no indices, the empty identity adds no entries or quadratic contribution. d=n and exact multiples are included. No r>0 or d%n!=0 premise is required.
coordinate_adapter.private_owner: blockCoordinates is a meaning-carrying private adapter audited recursively under the two public theorem interfaces; it receives no separate source-credit theorem.

linear_algebra_semantics.orthogonalGroup: Real orthogonal group, no SO(n) restriction; Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff / iff prime at UnitaryGroup.lean:297-302 provide both transpose products.
linear_algebra_semantics.IsHermitian: For real matrices this is symmetry, since real star is trivial.
linear_algebra_semantics.quadratic_forms: dotProduct x x=sum_i x_i^2 and mulVec is standard matrix-vector multiplication; this is Euclidean 2-norm squared, never the Pi sup norm.
linear_algebra_semantics.Loewner: Explicit symmetry plus all-vector quadratic inequalities faithfully replaces I<=A<=kappa I in semidefinite order without accidentally using entrywise matrix order.
